territorial_scope.description: Applies to licensees under Chapter 57 of Title 40 of the South Carolina Code.

evidence.quote: A licensee under this chapter is responsible for any and all work product produced by him or with the assistance of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar programs.

summary.short: Adds S.C. Code § 40-57-820 to Chapter 57, Title 40. A licensee under the chapter is responsible for all work product produced by or with AI, machine learning or similar programs. Violations committed through such programs are treated as the licensee's own violations.
summary.long: The excerpt contains only Section 4 of the bill, which adds Section 40-57-820 to Article 7, Chapter 57, Title 40 of the South Carolina Code. The new section makes a licensee under the chapter responsible for any and all work product produced by the licensee or with the assistance of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar programs. It further provides that a violation of the chapter committed through the use of these programs is treated as if committed directly by the licensee. The excerpt states no effective date, and the text does not describe any separate enforcement procedure, penalty or definition of the programs covered.
